title: QUIC RFC 9000 DATA_BLOCKED Frame Focused Proof Verification
verification_method: Focused S19P12 requirement-home tests, Release build, QuicFrameCodec benchmark Dry run, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, SpecTrace JSON validation, and whitespace diff checking.
scope: This verification covers DATA_BLOCKED parser and formatter behavior, type 0x14 fixed-frame encoding, Maximum Data variable-length integer handling, frame-boundary consumption, and connection-level blocking-limit field preservation for RFC 9000 Section 19.12 requirements 0003, 0004, and 0006.
expected_result: Focused S19P12 requirement homes prove that DATA_BLOCKED frames use the fixed type 0x14, reject non-minimal type encodings, preserve and format the Maximum Data varint field across width boundaries, reject truncated or out-of-range Maximum Data encodings, and consume only the DATA_BLOCKED frame bytes.
procedure: Run the focused S19P12 requirement-home filter.
Run the QuicFrameCodec benchmark suite with BenchmarkDotNet Dry job.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: The existing QuicFrameCodec DATA_BLOCKED parser and formatter are the wire-format seam under test.
The existing QuicDataBlockedFrame immutable view remains the field carrier under test.
Runtime flow-control emission remains owned by the existing Section 4 and Section 19.12 runtime artifact family.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim new DATA_BLOCKED emission scheduling, flow-control autotuning, asynchronous credit waiting, sender/recovery retransmission behavior, public flow-control APIs, or hosted endpoint close-packet behavior beyond the parser and formatter seams.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-05. Regenerated QUIC coverage triage marks REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S19P12-0003, REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S19P12-0004, and REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S19P12-0006 as trace_clean with fuzz required and no missing required coverage. Release build succeeded with 0 warnings and 0 errors. Focused S19P12 requirement-home tests passed 17/17. SpecTrace core validation passed for 397 JSON artifacts. BenchmarkDotNet Dry smoke executed ParseDataBlockedFrame and FormatDataBlockedFrame. git diff --check passed.
